Hi Jake / Anna —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap:
- MedSure is evaluating Redwood for a clinical routing & summarization feature that will touch patient identifiers and other PHI.
- Primary concerns: BAA availability, SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency, encryption (in transit & at rest), and the vendor security questionnaire.
- Desired timeline: decision by end of Q1, with procurement/BAA negotiation shortly after.

What Redwood can provide today (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report: available under NDA. We can share a redacted copy once NDA is in place.
- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments.

Hosted shared API is generally not eligible for PHI unless specific contractual & architectural controls are put in place — for now recommend Dedicated/Private.
- Encryption: TLS in transit is standard. At-rest encryption is enabled; customer-managed keys (KMS) are available for Private deployments.

Requested next steps:
1) Please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (MedSure_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) and return with any follow-ups.
2) If you can sign an NDA, we’ll share the SOC 2 Type II redacted report (we can route the NDA via DocuSign).
3) We’ll loop in our security lead (Vivek) and legal (Ethan) for a short follow-up call next week to discuss BAA terms and PHI boundaries. Proposed times: Feb 15–17 morning PT.

I’ve cc’d Vivek and Ethan to help with any technical/legal follow-ups. Happy to chat if you want a verbal walkthrough of the questionnaire.

Thanks — see inline answers below and next steps. Happy to jump on a call with Vivek/Ethan present if you prefer a walkthrough.

Answers / clarifications:
1) BAA scope: Redwood’s standard approach is to offer a BAA for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) modes. Hosted (shared) API is not supported for PHI in our standard offering; we do not sign BAAs for shared-hosted environments today. If you have a strong business case, our legal team can evaluate, but the typical path is Dedicated/Private for PHI.

2) Logs & retention: For Dedicated/Private, logs can be routed to your VPC or retained per the contract; retention windows are configurable. For Hosted, request metadata and audit logs are kept according to our retention policy (we’ll share specifics in the SOC 2). We can discuss log-routing options on Dedicated.

3) Encryption: Hosted uses provider-managed keys by default. Dedicated supports customer-managed keys (KMS) and Private/on-prem can use your hardware-backed HSM.

4) SOC 2 timeline: Once an NDA is in place we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II within 48 business hours.

- Looping Vivek for a technical confirmation and to draft an initial BAA for your review.
- Routing the DocuSign NDA link once you confirm the signer and we’ll get the SOC 2 over.

Hi Jake / team —

Thanks for the questions — wanted to chime in with technical specifics and an initial BAA draft attached. High level:

- PHI eligibility: Redwood supports PHI only on Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC or on-prem) deployments. We do not accept PHI via the shared Hosted API.

- Data handling: Inference requests are processed in memory; by default we do not persist model outputs beyond what is needed for request tracing and debugging. For Dedicated/Private, we can configure no-persist modes and route audit logs directly to your logging endpoint.

- Logs & KV cache: KV cache is ephemeral per-host; we can enforce policies to flush caches between sessions for increased isolation. Application-level logs can be forwarded to your Syslog/Cloud logging.

- Encryption: TLS 1.2+/TLS 1.3 in transit. At rest encryption is supported; Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS keys, Private can integrate with your HSM.

- SOC 2 and evidence: we’ll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II under NDA (we can share within 48 business hours of NDA execution).

Attached: Redwood_BAA_Draft_v1.pdf (initial draft). Please review and flag any clauses to escalate to our legal team.

Next step suggestions:
1) If you’re comfortable, sign the NDA so we can share SOC 2.
2) Complete the questionnaire and return; I’ll review answers and respond with any technical clarifications.
3) Schedule the 30-minute technical + legal sync on Feb 16/17.

Happy to join the call and walk through the BAA draft.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
